note.label: Joseph in Egypt: Then & Now

precepts.why:
“They shall not dwell in the Lord’s land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.”

Ephraim shall return to Egypt: that is the spiritual Egypt of Revelation 11:8, “the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.” The Joseph who once ruled Egypt has returned to Egypt again, this time in captivity, in the western hemisphere.

And there they eat unclean things. Just like Ephraim, so all the tribes, as Ezekiel 4:13 shows. The same captivity and the same defiled bread fall on the whole house of Israel among the nations.

precepts.text: Ephraim is planted in a pleasant place, the islands, but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer: willingly seeking to mix their children lighter to improve the race, as the doctrine of la raza taught. Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts: God says he will deal himself with the seed of the oppressor mixed in. Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up.
precepts.point: Y'all see that right there? That's right.

note.label: Joseph in Egypt: Then & Now

precepts.why:
“As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.” “Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them.”

“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place”: that pleasant place is what Moses and Jacob spoke of, the islands, the fruitful bough by a well. “but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” Ephraim would willingly give their children over to improve the race, as the doctrine of la raza taught: wanting children with straight hair, light skin and lighter eyes, not the nappy hair. That is what the Bible said Ephraim would do.

“Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” God says he will deal himself with the seed of the oppressor mixed in; so don't worry about it, brothers, just teach. “Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.”

Joseph was blessed with “blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.” When Ephraim mixed with the murderer, that same blessing was turned: a miscarrying womb and dry breasts. The root of the fruitful bough is dried up because of the mixing.

precepts.text: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place, that island of Puerto Rico, but shall bring forth his children to the murderer; a miscarrying womb and dry breasts. Light or dark, the Lord knows exactly who the northern kingdom is and made sure the seed continued.
precepts.point: Ephraim hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned. Like a pancake, white on top and brown underneath. The whitening campaigns were strategic, to make us forget our heritage.

note.label: The Iranians & The Ephesians

precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown. We still have that, but you have a lot of light skin, and it was strategic. The whitening campaigns across Latin America were a war on blackness, meant to make us forget our heritage: grandmothers praising good hair and light babies, textbooks erasing black heroes, children taught not to embrace their nose, their lips or their skin. That is how you colonize a people from the inside out. This devil is very evil and very strategic, but there is a God.

“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The pleasant place is the island of Puerto Rico. Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph. “Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.”

A lot of misinformed and uneducated people think the northern kingdom is not Israel just because they are light-skinned. No. The Lord knows exactly who they are, and the Lord made sure the seed would continue. It doesn't matter if they are light or dark; the Lord knows who is who, just as he knew that Asher would land in Brazil, and Brazil is Hebrew for iron. The Lord didn't make a mistake.

So the cake not turned is still Ephraim. Mixed among the people and whitened on top, brought forth to the murderer in a pleasant place, the northern kingdom is still the children of Israel, and the curses on them prove it.

precepts.text: All these curses shall come upon thee and overtake thee, because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord.
precepts.point: Ephraim is planted in a pleasant place but shall bring forth his children to the murderer. God gave the whitening a miscarrying womb and dry breasts, so much of what remains is still Israel.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
Ephraim was “planted in a pleasant place”, the blessings, but “Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The murderer is Cain, Esau, Edom: the Spaniards, the United States. That was the whitening, el blanqueamiento, sometimes done willingly and sometimes not. So God said “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of the babies of those who tried to whiten us out died, and what is left behind is largely not European; many who look European there came over later. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort as Christ taught, and let God do the separating.

How could a people fall so low, go through so much, and still rise and reconnect to their identity? People are baffled by it; to them it is ignorant and even offensive for us to know who we are. Deuteronomy 28:45 answers it: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.” And “they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.”

Those curses became our identity, and our redemption. They are the way we acknowledge who we are and make our way back. If not these curses, then who is it? The Bible always said Israel would come back to its identity, and now that we are back, the world is bugging out. Where are the lost tribes? They are here now.

It is God's grand plan. If we were all together in one spot, they could have wiped us out. By dispersing us into the four corners of the earth he also preserved us, like the worm in the movie Swordfish, broken up and scattered to the four corners of the internet so no one could get it back without the one who hid it. What was our curse, God meant for good, so that now we can come back together. As Hosea said, the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, and “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”. We are reaping what we have sown, especially the northern kingdom. Hosea 9 says we went a whoring from our God: we sought after the other nations and their ideals and made deals with them, and so “Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.” That is servitude, dependence, and our resources consumed by others.

The oil, the land, the assets: everything the nations say we stole from them is really the fruit of our land, eaten up by a nation we knew not. Others eat our labour. That is what the whole documentary The End of Poverty is about.

The other nations are the ministers of evil unto us for the evil that we have done. Just as there is prophecy for Babylon that great city, there is prophecy for us, and this is it: oppressed and crushed alway, in Venezuela, Cuba, and all through Latin America.

precepts.text: Thou shalt serve thine enemies in hunger, thirst, nakedness and want of all things.
precepts.point: This is prophecy for the northern kingdom in the Americas.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” This is for the northern kingdom especially. Our breakdown of it has often been very United States based, but when you go to these other countries you have to give the sense this way, because the people there are fully aware of the robbing of their resources.

Why these things in particular, hunger, thirst, nakedness and want of all things? Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 39:26 names the chief things of life: “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.” When you target those things you dehumanize a people, taking away what is needful for them to live dignified. That is why they will never let the resources in their backyard be controlled by the people who own them, here or in Africa. “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Because we have not repented of what Hosea 9 describes, we will not reclaim them until the Redeemer comes; in the meantime we must repent and keep the laws, statutes and commandments.

Sirach 34:21 shows it is violence: “The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.” You think violence has to be a sword, a bomb or a bullet, but “he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.” The man in the documentary worked all day and still had nothing to go home to eat.

Lamentations 5 is the same picture: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You see it now in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread”, just as Hosea 9 says: we have given the power and sovereignty of our resources to Babylon the Great, the United States, and other nations, and China is working its way into Latin America. “Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.” With the Monroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary and the big stick, the northern kingdom is still paying for the sins of the forefathers. “Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.”

Chains do not have to be chains anymore; this is economic slavery, and that is why Deuteronomy 28:48 is so profound. Baruch 3:8: “we are yet this day in our captivity”, “to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.” That is the key. We need this compassion to reach in and touch our people's souls. Babylon is speaking plainly; so must we.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

precepts.why:
Their abominations were according as they loved. “And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations”: God gave us the law, the commandments, the judgments, and we changed it into wickedness, more than the other nations. You ever seen an Edomite homosexual? You’re like, yeah, he’s gay or whatever. But when you see a Jake homosexual, oh my gosh. When you go to some of these places, it’s outright ridiculous. We take sin to the utmost extreme. What are we reading in the Bible? It shows just that: we are the people, in our greatness and in our folly.

“And my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.” God did everything for us, but that’s what happens when you spoil somebody. When you spoil a child, are they ever grateful? No. That’s Israel: we are that spoiled child. We had everything handed to us and we forsook our father.

note.label: THE REWARD OF THE RIGHTEOUS: WHO IS REALLY GETTING IN?

“My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.” The Lord cast away the northern kingdom because they would not listen. Not a people means scattered among the nations. It was never talking about the Moabites. The northern kingdom today is out wandering, crossing themselves at the church with rosary beads around their necks.
